question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing goalkeeper, Bob is playing left winger, Claire is playing right back, Dave is playing cheerleader, Eve is playing striker, Fred is playing left back, and Gertrude is playing right winger.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Dave and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Eve and Bob trade positions. Then, Claire and Dave trade positions. Then, Claire and Bob trade positions. Then, Dave and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Fred and Gertrude trade positions. Finally, Eve and Bob trade positions. At the end of the match, Dave is playing
Options:
(A) goalkeeper
(B) left winger
(C) right back
(D) cheerleader
(E) striker
(F) left back
(G) right winger
solution:
Players, in order: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve | Fred | Gertrude
Initial: goalkeeper | left winger | right back | cheerleader | striker | left back | right winger
1. Dave ↔ Gertrude: goalkeeper | left winger | right back | right winger | striker | left back | cheerleader
2. Eve ↔ Bob: goalkeeper | striker | right back | right winger | left winger | left back | cheerleader
3. Claire ↔ Dave: goalkeeper | striker | right winger | right back | left winger | left back | cheerleader
4. Claire ↔ Bob: goalkeeper | right winger | striker | right back | left winger | left back | cheerleader
5. Dave ↔ Gertrude: goalkeeper | right winger | striker | cheerleader | left winger | left back | right back
6. Fred ↔ Gertrude: goalkeeper | right winger | striker | cheerleader | left winger | right back | left back
7. Eve ↔ Bob: goalkeeper | left winger | striker | cheerleader | right winger | right back | left back
Dave is playing cheerleader, option (D).
Final answer: (D)
